findings.claim: The generated role-native metadata omits Kimi Code even though the change requires per-harness model/tool coverage for all five harnesses.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria: "Each role gets ... a Harness card (skills, tools and model per harness)" and "Harness card names all five harnesses"; build-manifest.mjs `nativeFor` returns `{ claude, codex, opencode, minimax: { model: config.models.minimax[t] } }` with no `kimi` entry, while `HARNESSES` includes `kimi`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a Kimi native entry in `nativeFor`, e.g. `kimi: { model: config.models.kimi[t] }`, and add a unit test asserting every role's `native` block contains all five harness keys.
